cards.title: Core idea
cards.body: Application security makes sure only the right users and systems reach the right data and actions. Start from the OWASP Top 10 and threat-model with STRIDE before building.

cards.title: How it works
cards.body: Enforce authorization on the server for every request, use parameterized queries, encrypt in transit with TLS and at rest with managed keys, keep secrets in a secrets manager, patch dependencies, and log and alert on security events. SSRF in the cloud can reach the metadata endpoint; use IMDSv2 and allowlists.

questions.q: Does a session cookie prove authentication or authorization?
questions.a: Only authentication. Authorization must be checked per request against the specific resource.

questions.q: Changing /invoices/1001 to 1002 shows another company's invoice. Fix?
questions.a: Scope the lookup to the caller's tenant or check permission, return 404 or 403, and add authorization tests.

questions.q: An access key was pushed to a public repo. First step?
questions.a: Deactivate or rotate the key immediately, then check its usage, purge history and fix the process.
